segments.name: Tourism products
segments.description: Sells airline tickets and luxury travel packages to business clients' online platforms.
segments.evidence: Management currently identifies the Company's three sales models as operating segments, which are tourism products, technology and cross-border merchandise.

segments.name: Technology
products: Software Solution for Tourism Cross-border operation
software development and technology support services
segments.description: Provides software solutions and technology support for tourism cross-border operations.
segments.evidence: The focus on our technology solution has enabled us to achieve significant growth since 2020 by facilitating tourism cross-border commerce and offering services in tourism and airline tickets.

segments.name: Cross-border merchandise
segments.description: Wholesales duty-free and cross-border consumer goods, with logistics and supply chain services.
segments.evidence: In 2024, the Company expanded its business operations in cross-border merchandize segment, and during 2025, it continues focusing on wholesale trade sector and specializing in duty-free and cross-border consumer goods.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for airline tickets, tourism packages, technology services and cross-border consumer goods the company sells.
revenueModel.evidence: Included in the "travel service", majority of the revenue amount represents the revenue for reselling of air-tickets requests by airline ticket agencies.
